requirement.statement: The project SHALL ship one eidolon executable that owns the interactive TUI and all headless, workflow and global CLI subcommands.

case.given: A user invokes `eidolon` with no subcommand or with a project path
case.when: The unified command parses the invocation
case.then: It SHALL launch the interactive TUI

case.given: A user invokes `eidolon workflow`, `eidolon global`, `eidolon exec` or another registered headless subcommand
case.when: The unified command parses the invocation
case.then: It SHALL execute that subcommand from the same compiled program

case.given: The project build and install surfaces are inspected
case.then: There MUST be no eidolon-cli command, headless-only entry, package build script or install script

replace.given: A user invokes `eidolon workflow agent /dev/stdin` or `eidolon workflow agent -` with a shell heredoc
